description:
Seattle cost estimate: range, material/labor split, days, line items.

Fields per type below; their allowed values, ranges and pricing rules are in list_project_types. ?=optional; (mat)=get_material_options ID (a unique close name also resolves; an ambiguous one lists candidates).

interior-painting: rooms([{id,name,length,width,height,paintCeiling,paintTrim,doorCount,windowCount,surfaceCondition,trimComplexity,wallTexture,roomEmpty}]); paintQuality(mat); includesPrimer; majorColorChange?(+colorChange{currentColor,targetColor})
exterior-painting: wallArea,trimArea; doorCount; paintQuality(mat); surfacePrepLevel; includesPrimer; stories?; colorChange?(+colorChangeData{currentColor,targetColor})
flooring: rooms([{id,name,length,width}]); flooringMaterial(mat); includesUnderlayment,includesBaseboard,includesRemoval,includesSubfloorPrep; underlaymentType?,baseboardType?(mat); baseboardLinearFeet?; removalType?; transitionCount?
deck: deckType; dimensions({length,width≤200,height≤30 ft}); deckingMaterial(mat); framingMaterial(mat); includesRailing,includesStairs; railingMaterial?,finishType?(mat); railingLinearFeet?; stairSteps?; landingRequired?; deckShape?; skirtingType?; existingDeckWorkItems?
windows: windows([{id,windowType,width,height,quantity}]); qualityLevel; includesTrimWork,includesRemoval,energyEfficient; trimMaterial?(mat)
siding: wallArea; sidingMaterial(mat); homeHeight; includesInsulation,includesRemoval,soffit; insulationType?(mat); existingSidingType?; trimLinearFeet; soffitLinearFeet?
fence: linearFeet; fenceMaterial(mat); height; gateCount; gateWidth?; style?; terrain; includesRemoval,concreteFootings
landscaping: yardArea; includesIrrigation,includesSod,includesMulch,includesSitePrep; irrigationType?; irrigationZones?; sodSquareFeet?; mulchSquareFeet?; plants?([{id,plantType,quantity,size}]); hardscapeFeatures?([{id,featureType,squareFeet,material}])
kitchen: kitchenSize; scope; cabinets; countertop; appliances; flooring; backsplash?,plumbingRelocation?,electricalUpgrade?,island?,lighting?; wallRemoval?; gasLine?,rangeHood?
bathroom: bathroomType; bathroomSize; scope; showerTub; vanity; tileWork; showerWalls?; heatedFloors?,newLighting?,ventilation?,plumbingRelocation?,glassDoor?,showerSeat?,handShower?; grabBars?
basement: basementSize; scope; ceilingHeight; moistureCondition; egress; bathroom; kitchenette; bedroomCount?; flooring; insulation; hvac; electricalSubpanel?,homeAgePre1978?
adu: type; sizeSqft; finishTier; dadu only: foundation?,sitework?,utilityRunFeet?,preApprovedPlan?; treeRemovalCount?; homeAgePre1978?
ada: projectScope; modifications({grabBars,walkInShower,widerDoorways,ramp,nonSlipFlooring,leverHandles,raisedToilet,rollUnderSink,accessibleCounters,stairLift}, ≥1 true); currentCondition; homeStories?; doorwayCount?; rampLengthFeet?; flooringSquareFeet?
electrical: items[{id,quantity}] (ids: get_material_options)
plumbing: items[{id,quantity}] (ids: get_material_options)
garage-doors: items[{id,quantity}] (ids: get_material_options)
doors: items[{id,quantity}] (ids: get_material_options)
concrete: items[{id,quantity}] (ids: get_material_options)
insulation: items[{id,quantity}] (ids: get_material_options)
gutters: items[{id,quantity}] (ids: get_material_options)

project.description: Project input fields — named per projectType in the tool description; allowed values in list_project_types.

name: get_estimate

primarySource.description: Present when Kolmo verified but does not author the fact — cite both.

sourceUrl.description: The specific page these facts render on. Link this, not the site root.

contingencyCost.description: Present on basement and adu. When set, a contingency is ALREADY in totalCost — do not add another.

estimateRange.description: Planning range for Seattle-area work. This is what to relay, with its qualifier attached.

excludes.description: Scope NOT priced here. Relay alongside any figure.

permitCost.description: Present on deck, kitchen, bathroom, basement, adu and ada. Already inside totalCost.

totalCost.description: Point figure. Relay estimateRange instead — a single number reads as a quote.

title: Seattle cost estimate
